title: LFI's Chikirou Acquitted of Fraud but Convicted for Theft in 'Le Média' Trial
detail: Sophia Chikirou, a senior La France Insoumise (LFI) politician and former campaign director for Jean-Luc Mélenchon, was acquitted of fraud (tentative d'escroquerie) but convicted and fined for theft of checks belonging to the left-wing outlet 'Le Média', which she co-founded. The mixed verdict in the politically charged trial drew significant attention given Chikirou's prominent role in the French left and her ties to the LFI media ecosystem.

title: Michel Platini Files Legal Complaint Against FIFA's Infantino for Influence Peddling
detail: Former French football captain and UEFA president Michel Platini filed a formal legal complaint against FIFA President Gianni Infantino, accusing him of influence peddling (trafic d'influence) and malicious denunciation (dénonciation calomnieuse). The complaint escalates a long-running feud between the two figures rooted in Platini's 2015 FIFA ban, which he has consistently blamed on Infantino's alleged interference. The case marks a significant new chapter in the legal and political battles surrounding global football governance.
